title: Zesty Fluffy Dutch Andouille Hash
description: A peppery, fluffy Dutch dish featuring Andouille sausage, perfect for a lazy Sunday morning, made with ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients and a deglaze fond for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the diced potatoes with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
While the potatoes are roasting, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Andouille sausage to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and smoked paprika to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the roasted potatoes to the skillet and stir to combine with the sausage and vegetables.
Pour the chicken broth into the skillet and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the hash for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
